reason: shadcn's sonner.tsx is a themed wrapper of the React-only sonner library: toasts are created by calling the imperative toast() function, and the library injects its own stylesheet. A Phlex port with no JavaScript dependency (maintainer constraint of the phlex-shadcn-adoption epic) re-implements the library's Toaster/Toast behavior in the toast_stack primitive and ships its stylesheet as sonner.css, so the rendered toast DOM, the data-* state attributes, the stacking variables and the computed styles equal the oracle (81 scenarios). The differences are the ones a server-rendered Rails app needs or React elements force: (1) Rails-idiomatic entry points that React has no equivalent for: the flash (Toaster.new(flash:)), a Sonner::Toast <template> that a Turbo Stream appends to the Toaster id, and the chadcn--sonner:show event; (2) Toaster id: is the HTML id of the section (the Turbo Stream target) because Ruby has no separate DOM id for sonner's `id` prop, which is toaster_id:; (3) a caller class: is merged with 'toaster group' (R6) instead of replacing it; (4) React elements cannot exist in Ruby: toast(<jsx>), toast.custom(jsx), JSX icons, title/description components, React-element action/cancel and the useSonner hook are replaced by DOM nodes for toast.custom, server-side Phlex icons (icons:) and the event callbacks below; (5) onDismiss/onAutoClose/onClick callbacks of server-created toasts are the events chadcn--sonner:dismiss, :auto-close, :action and :cancel (the JS API still accepts the callbacks); (6) sonner announces everything through the polite section; an error toast is additionally written to an assertive role=alert region appended to <body> (outside the compared DOM) so errors interrupt; (7) the Lucide icons of each type and sonner's close icon are rendered once as inert <template data-chadcn--sonner-icon> children of the section (no data-slot, not rendered, not in the a11y tree) and cloned into each toast.
api: Toaster id: is the HTML id of the section (default toaster); sonner's id prop is toaster_id:
Toaster class: is added to 'toaster group' instead of replacing it
Toaster flash:, toasts: and the block render Sonner::Toast templates; Turbo Stream appends and the chadcn--sonner:show event also create toasts
toast.custom takes a DOM node or a function returning one; React elements, JSX icons and useSonner are not supported
onDismiss/onAutoClose/action/cancel of server-created toasts are the events chadcn--sonner:dismiss, :auto-close, :action, :cancel
An error toast is also announced through an assertive role=alert region appended to body
The icons of each type are inert <template data-chadcn--sonner-icon> children of the Toaster section (no data-slot)
